1. E-Mail und Passwort deines Miele-App-:
1. Enter your Miele app account email and password and click 'Sign in'.
2. Note: After login, the page will hang on a spinning loading wheel (or show an error). This is completely normal and indicates success!
1. Im Netzwerk-Tab (F12) ganz nach unten:
1. In the Network tab (F12), scroll to the very last (often red) request starting with 'redirect?redirect_uri=miele...' or 'miele://oauth2-code/...'.
2. Right-click that entry ➔ 'Copy URL' / 'Copy link address'.
3. Paste the URL into the field below and click 'Fetch GroupKey'.
1. Oben auf „Login-Seite öffnen“ klicken:
1. Click 'Open login page' above (a new browser tab opens).
2. In the new tab, press F12 and switch to the 'Network' tab.
3. Enable persistent logging:
   • Chrome / Edge / Brave: Check 'Preserve log'.
   • Firefox: Click gear ⚙️ ➔ check 'Persist Logs'.
Achtung: Bei aktivierter Steuerung werde: Caution: with control enabled, writable datapoints are created (start/stop/pause, light, on/off). Commands additionally require "MobileStart/remote control" to be enabled on the appliance. Some firmwares (e.g. refrigeration) reject write commands entirely.
Antwortet ein manuell eingetragenes Gerä: If a manually entered device stops answering, the adapter probes its own /24 network once (at most every 30 minutes). Needed when the appliances get their IP via DHCP and mDNS does not get through - for instance inside a Docker bridge network.
Bei Ausfall die neue IP im Subnetz suche: Search the subnet for the new IP if a device drops out
Bei aktiviertem Push geben sich der Adap: With push enabled, the adapter presents itself as a household peer and the appliances send state changes in real time. For this, the port selected below must be reachable INBOUND on the ioBroker host from the appliance network (firewall). UDP 5353 (mDNS) is needed anyway. Without push NO inbound port is required – then only polling is used.
Benötigte Ports: eingehend TCP <Push-Por: Required ports: inbound TCP <push port> (only with push) · UDP 5353 mDNS · outbound TCP 80 to the appliances · outbound TCP 443 to miele-iot.com only during login.
Der Adapter ermittelt die lokalen Zugang: The adapter retrieves local credentials (GroupID/GroupKey) once by signing in with your Miele account. The Miele app continues to work as before. No credentials are transmitted to third parties.
Der Adapter schreibt jedes abgeschlossen: The adapter records every completed cycle: duration, program, energy and water. The appliances do not keep finished cycles themselves, so the history starts when you enable this – it cannot be filled retroactively. Recent cycles are available as JSON under <serial>.history.cyclesJson, the totals next to it.
Die Vorgaben stammen von einer WCR860 un: The defaults come from a WCR860 and are correct there. On other models the fields may sit elsewhere - the adapter then reports implausible values, such as a number that never changes across different programmes. The "Record raw fields" option helps find the right index: the field whose value grows during a running programme is the one you want.
Diese Werte werden normalerweise über di: These values are normally set during login. Enter them manually only if GroupID/GroupKey are already known (e.g. from MieleRESTServer). The GroupKey is stored encrypted.
Docker: Läuft ioBroker im Container, mus: Docker: if ioBroker runs in a container, the push port must be reachable inbound AND the appliances must reach the container at a real LAN IP. This reliably works only with "network_mode: host" (the port is then open automatically). On a bridge network additionally map "-p <push port>:<push port>" – but push usually still does not work there, because the callback address sits behind NAT. Without push no inbound port is required.
EcoFeedback wird per DOP2 gelesen und st: EcoFeedback is read via DOP2 and is only available on appliances that provide it (so far washing machines). Values were checked for plausibility against the Miele cloud adapter; the field indices may differ per model.
Energie, Wasser und Dauer je Programm mi: Energy, water and duration per cycle, timestamped at the end of the cycle – so charts can cover any period.
Energiezähler: Der Verbrauch eines Progr: Energy meter: a programme's consumption cannot be read from the appliance — the figure Miele reports is an expectation, not a measurement. If you have a metering socket in front of it, enter its meter datapoint here; the adapter then records for every programme what was actually used.
Freiwillig und standardmäßig aus. Legt j: Optional, off by default. Creates the state eco.felderJson per device and writes every field of the eco leaf into it, not just the two that are evaluated. Useful when energy or water readings are wrong or missing on your model: the field indices differ between series, and a recorded programme run reveals the correct ones. The values stay in your own ioBroker instance - nothing is transmitted and nothing is analysed.
Hinweis: Die automatische Suche nutzt Mu: Note: automatic discovery uses multicast (mDNS, UDP 5353) and only finds appliances in the same broadcast network. In a Docker container with bridge networking, multicast does NOT get through – in that case there is no auto-discovery; enter the appliance IPs below manually instead (no multicast/port is needed for that). Auto-discovery only works in the host network (network_mode: host).
Hinweis: Nicht alle Geräte unterstützen: Note: not all appliances support push. Older/simple Wi-Fi modules (e.g. XKM EK037/EK057) have no SuperVision endpoint – subscriptions are accepted, but no push events arrive. In that case polling remains. Push additionally requires the host network (see below).
Ist der Haken gesetzt, werden die Datenp: If ticked, datapoint names are created bilingually (en/de) and the admin shows them in German. Without the tick, English only. The change takes effect after saving/restarting.
Nach erfolgreicher Ermittlung stehen Gro: Once retrieved, GroupID and encrypted GroupKey appear on the 'Advanced' tab. Don't forget to save.
Schritt 1: Auf „Login-Seite öffnen\" kli: Step 1: Click "Open login page" and sign in with your Miele account in the browser. At the end the browser tries to open an address of the form "miele://oauth2-code/?code=…&state=…". This complete address (the "code") is needed in step 2.
Schritt 3: Adresse kopieren & GroupKey e: Step 3: Copy redirect address & fetch GroupKey
Wie viele der letzten Programme in cycle: How many recent cycles are kept in cyclesJson. Meant for quick display; long-term data comes from the history adapter.
Zusätzlich in den History-Adapter schrei: Also write to the history adapter
Ältere Einträge fallen aus dem Ringpuffe: Older entries drop out of the ring buffer. 730 days is two years.
Der Teilungsfaktor rechnet den Rohwert d: The divisor converts the raw value of the water field into litres. On the WCR860, field 21 counts in steps of 5 ml, so the divisor is 200. Uneven values do occur: the data collection estimates the divisor from collected programmes and reports it in its analysis.
